## Problem and resulting behavior / 问题与修改后的行为

Describe the concrete task, limitation and change. / 说明具体任务、限制与修改。

## Validation / 验证

List relevant checks and remaining limitations. / 列出相关检查与剩余限制。

## Documentation and scope / 文档与范围

- [ ] Public behavior changes are reflected in both language editions, or not applicable. / 公开行为变化已同步双语说明，或不适用。
- [ ] Added guidance is routed from the owning skill; claims have source support. / 新指导可从所属技能访问，主张有来源支持。
- [ ] No confidential manuscript data or unlicensed reference assets are included. / 未包含保密稿件数据或无许可参考资源。
